title: Purified Two-Relaxation-Time Lattice Boltzmann Method: Removing Ghost Modes from TRT for Enhanced Stability
summary: The two-relaxation-time (TRT) lattice Boltzmann model is widely adopted for its simplicity and tunable boundary accuracy. However, its collision operator relaxes the full symmetric non-equilibrium component, implicitly retaining non-hydrodynamic ghost modes that degrade stability at high Reynolds numbers. In this work, we establish a rigorous connection between ghost-mode filtering and regularization within the TRT framework.
